title: Silas and the Confession
author: S. M. Ishikawa
blurb: Rafael Galloway, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
